This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply: Metadata PDF window states a Data Supply Spatial Reference System must be supplied and the published SpatialNI guidance identifies Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as a SpatialNI data-supply SRS. However, the document does not identify the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone resource or its archive-internal tiles as using EPSG:29902. The official PDF text was readable through the public no-login document endpoint, while screenshot retrieval returned Cache miss; therefore EPSG:29902 is retained only as a platform-level candidate and is not fabricated as dataset-specific CRS proof.
